name: B10-0333/2026 – After § 5 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the impact of the Turkish invasion on Cypriot women and girls, and the crimes committed by Turkish forces and consequences on gender equality
part_text: 5a. Affirms that the division of the island and the ongoing conflict perpetuate a climate of militarisation, nationalism and military spending that diverts resources away from key social policies aimed at promoting equality (care services, housing, healthcare, and shelters for victims of gender-based violence); considers that there will be no fair solution in Cyprus without far-reaching demilitarisation, full recognition of sexual violence as a war crime, and a leading role for women in shaping the island’s constitutional and economic future;
